references.text: Caleb, son of Jephunneh, is promised the land because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
Caleb receives Hebron as his inheritance because he followed the Lord, the God of Israel, with all his heart.
The fulfillment of the promise to Caleb, where he receives his inheritance in the land.
Caleb shows his faithfulness by encouraging the people to enter the land, unlike the other spies.
Caleb and Joshua were the only ones from that generation allowed to enter the promised land.
Caleb followed the Lord wholeheartedly and therefore inherits the land.
Moses recounts the promise given to Caleb about the land because of his faithfulness.
Caleb receives Hebron as his inheritance, just as Moses had promised.
A prayer for a new and willing spirit, connected to the concept of 'a different spirit' in Caleb.
The warning against unbelief that kept the Israelites from entering the rest, while Caleb faithfully followed the Lord.
